text:
Diego L: hey all, first day here — quick security/setup questions from a contractor perspective: 1) my Win laptop shows BitLocker suspended and a recovery key prompt, should i enter anything or open a ticket? 2) i got a yubikey in my welcome kit 1 how do i register it for dev/sysaccess and okta? 3) are contractors included in the phishing sim this month or is there an exemption process?

Rina K: welcome Diego! :tada: for BitLocker do NOT enter any unknown recovery key. open a ticket and include the screenshot. we manage recovery keys via MDM->Intune so we'll re-sync and push the key escrow. if you can run `manage-bde -status` and paste output that's helpful.

Helpdesk Bot: Ticket created: HD-61245 (owner: Rina K) for BitLocker recovery sync. ETA 1-3 hours. Please attach the screenshot to the ticket.

Diego L: attaching screenshot now (sent to ticket). `manage-bde -status` shows: "Protection Status: Protection Off, Lock Status: Unlocked"

Rina K: thanks. that matches a suspended protection. i'll trigger the Intune policy reapply. don't attempt `manage-bde -protectors -add` unless instructed.

Security Team: quick YubiKey steps: browse to https://okta.redwood.internal -> Security Methods -> Add Security Method -> YubiKey. register the device while on VPN for initial bind. for dev/sysaccess we use the same YubiKey; after Okta registration, request system access via the access form and attach the confirmation screenshot. we usually require a manager sign-off for contractor elevated roles.

Diego L: cool, i'm on VPN now and will register. one more on phishing sims1 contractor policy?

People Ops Bot: Contractors are included in the baseline phishing simulation unless an exemption is approved for specific legal/air-gapped contractors. To request an exemption, open the contractor-compliance form and attach justification + manager approval.

Rina K: note on the BitLocker: i've re-applied the Intune profile to your device serial ending in 7F2. it should auto-enable within ~25 minutes. i'll update the ticket when Key Escrow shows up.

Diego L: thanks Rina. registered YubiKey in Okta successfully. request filed for dev/sysaccess (tagged my manager).

Helpdesk Bot: HD-61245 updated: Intune profile re-apply started by Rina K.

Security Team: FYI Diego 1 simulated phish will come from "security@redwood-sim.local" and may use familiar company-sounding language. reporting it by the Report Phish button completes the simulation. contractors who fail will receive the standard training nudge. exemptions must be pre-approved.

Diego L: understood. I'll wait on ticket update and report any suspicious emails. thanks everyone :pray:
